rationale.conceptual: The method (DFT slab calculations with NEB) is an established but non-trivial computational technique. It requires understanding of surface science, pseudopotentials, k-point sampling, geometry relaxation, and NEB barrier calculations. The physics is not novel, but implementing it correctly demands domain knowledge and careful parameter choices.

This involves multi-step orchestration, tool setup (Quantum ESPRESSO and pseudopotentials), and handling input/output across multiple runs, fitting a moderate engineering effort.
